town_description: Sabroom is a town in South Tripura district on the Bangladesh border, at the southern end of the Agartala-Sabroom highway and rail corridor. Rupaichhari and Manubankul (Manu Bankul) are nearby settlements in the Sabroom subdivision; the area hosts a large Buddhist (Mog/Marma community) population with many viharas and pagodas, including the upcoming Dhamma Dipa International Buddhist University at Manu Bankul.

travel.railway: Sabroom railway station, the southern terminus of the Agartala-Sabroom line, is the nearest railhead (verify distance).
travel.road: On the Agartala-Sabroom highway (NH-8) corridor; Baishnabpur/Rupaichhari is about 3.9 miles from Manubankul per the place listing (verify).
